en.html:
Ichijou"Ek minute—BEACH HOLIDAY?! Kab tay hua yeh bakchodi?! Why the hell are WE swimming about as if this is perfectly normal?!"
Kanae"Oh, but what can one say to that?"
Sayo"Upon arrival, Miss Ayane, everyone was found enjoying midsummer in the most ordinary manner."
Ichijou"Unko mana kiya kya?! Let THEM enjoy their bloody holiday! Hum kyun—why have WE joined the bathing party?!"
Kageaki"Intelligence work begins by blending into the situation. The foreign element in the scene, that you must not become."
Sayo"A statement of real depth. I should like to read it aloud to a certain person who wears blackish clothes and a blackish aura at all hours, and stands out against every surrounding like a lump of charcoal dropped into milk."
Kageaki"Yes. Absolutely correct."
Kanae"Does this man have even one symptom of self-awareness...?"
Ichijou"F-fine, blend! But swimsuit tak pahunch gaye?! Getting into swimsuits also became compulsory?!"
Kageaki"Nearby shops were selling only swimwear. No choice was there. Walking this beach in ordinary clothing would be recklessness."
Kanae"We would be drenched in sweat."
Sayo"Time to dehydration, I estimate, is about ninety minutes."
Ichijou"Uuugh..."

Still, if we were remaining here, reasons were there.

en.html:
Kageaki"Crossing is not possible."
Ichijou"...Eh? Why not?"
Kageaki"On the way here, I checked. At present the whole of Enoshima is a prohibited-entry zone."
Kageaki"The order is the shogunate's, naturally. Reason: unknown."
Ichijou"...Because of this weapons-research business?"
Kageaki"Possible."
Ichijou"Then what do we do?"
Kageaki"Openly we cannot cross, so not-openly we will cross. Bas. Finding the method is reason number two for remaining here."
Kageaki"Third, information. Normally I dislike stopping just short of the destination to ask everybody about the destination."
Kageaki"This time is different."
Ichijou"...Haan. Before going there, at least some idea of what the hell this situation is..."
Kageaki"Yes. As things stand, entering is not an attractive prospect."
Ichijou"It is summer, after all..."
Kageaki"It is summer..."

en.html:
Season: summer.

Calendar: the eleventh month. The year's end was almost here.

Summer was not entitled to be happening.

Garmi ko kisne bulaya? Who invited the heat? The calendar has almost finished its entire year's work, and this fellow arrives with the sea-bathing party. No, no, you carry on with November. I will do June here. Such territorial confidence, even the sun should feel embarrassed.

At the shrine, when I first heard it—and afterward, going over the information while explaining it to Ichijou—I had only half believed this dangerous Rokuhara research business. More doubt than belief, if anything.

Now the balance had gone the other way.

Something the shogunate was doing on that island. Probably.

研究という点については半信半疑、むしろ首を傾げる

　幕府はあの島で何かを行っているのだ――おそらく。

en.html:
Season: summer.

Calendar: the eleventh month. The year's end was almost here.

Summer was not entitled to be happening.

Garmi ko kisne bulaya? Who invited the heat? The calendar has almost finished its entire year's work, and this fellow arrives with the sea-bathing party. No, no, you carry on with November. I will do June here. Such territorial confidence, even the sun should feel embarrassed.

en.html:
Indeed.

At the shrine, when I first heard it, I had only half believed this secret Rokuhara research business. More doubt than belief, if anything.

Now the balance had gone the other way.

Something the shogunate was doing on that island. Probably.
